method: Independent Decimal arithmetic, not evaluation of the Guide expressions; legal branches checked against full art.254 and art.256.

cases.facts: Enumerated SARL; January owner; own occupation; supported annual rental value includes immediate indispensable dependency; no exemption; ordinary deduction applies.
cases.legal_decision: Art.255(1) uses hypothetical rental value for self-occupation. Zero cash rent does not imply zero tax.

cases.facts: Otherwise comparable SA properties; supported annual value; January ownership; no exemption. Legal burden of grosses réparations controls.
cases.legal_decision: Art.254 second paragraph switches off the full 50% deduction when the tenant bears major repairs. This is classification of existing burden, not an election; disputed classification remains held.
